content: One of the research outcomes from my Masters study has been published in Nature Scientific Reports (Q1) .
Paper on Semantic Segmentation in Natural Environments accepted at 44th IEEE IPCCC 2025, Texas, USA.
Completed field visit to Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU) for UAV-based aquatic plant data collection.
Conducted a robotics workshop at a local cadet college, introducing students to embedded systems and autonomous robots.
Research on aquatic plant segmentation featured in The Business Standard.
Paper accepted in Nature Scientific Data (Q1): AqUavplant dataset for aquatic plant classification using UAV imagery.
Paper accepted at ISCIT 2024 (Rank-B conference) on predicting depression using ML/DL with Explainable AI.
